Social Media Manager

We are looking for a Social Media Manager who can enhance our brand / our client’s brand and build strong online communities through our various social media platforms. The Social Media Manager will be responsible for developing and administering social media content that is designed to engage users and create an interactive relationship between consumers and the company. The successful candidate will also be required to collect and review social media data to develop more effective campaigns.

What you'll do

  • Curate social media strategies and execute campaigns to overachieve the expectation
  • Should be up to date with new digital technologies and social media best practices
  • Update the social media calendar and work closely with the creative team to develop high-quality content for our social media platforms.
  • Studying user behavior towards the brand on social media & curating an action plan to improve the brand health
  • Identifying the trends & converting them into a suggestion
  • Analyzing social media metrics & developing social analytics reports
  • Excellent time management – able to stay calm under pressure whilst working quickly and delivering to tight deadlines
  • Detail Matters – Should be able to spot the mistake in creative and copy
  • Comfortable working in a multicultural, multilingual environment
  • Ready to work on new, previously untested initiatives and is not deterred by failure
  • Excellent communicator and a people-oriented person who enjoys teamwork and working in a collaborative environment

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications or related field
  • 3+ years experience in social media management
  • Exceptional multi-tasking skills Able to explain complex social media data in an understandable way Strong problem-solving skills
  • Knowledge of Facebook’s advertising platform is required

Interested?

Send us your details and we'll get back to you within a few days.
